Venue: Binance
Headline: Binance Convert: Automate Your bStock Transactions and Share a Reward Pool of Up to 50 SPCXB

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance is excited to launch Phase 3 of the bStocks Recurring Transactions Campaign, giving eligible users more opportunities to explore bStocks through scheduled, automated purchases.
With bStock recurring transactions, eligible users can set a preferred schedule and let Binance automate their purchases – making market access simpler, more flexible, and easier to maintain over time.
## With bStock recurring transactions, eligible users can:
Automate purchases of supported bStocks at a preferred schedule.
Start small, with purchases from as little as 0.01 USDC equivalent.
Access fractional exposure to supported US shares through tokenized securities.
Trade 24/7 on Binance, subject to product and market availability.
Eligible users who set up and complete recurring bStock purchases during the Promotion Period may qualify to receive rewards from a total prize pool of 50 SPCXB in token vouchers, capped at 0.01 SPCXB per user.
Promotion Period: 2026-11-26 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-23 23:59 (UTC)
## How to Participate
During the Promotion Period, the first 5,000 eligible users* who fulfill all of the following criteria will be able to participate and equally share a reward pool of 50 SPCXB in token vouchers:
Register their participation via the promotion landing page;
Complete at least 75 USDC equivalent in cumulative bStock transactions through newly created Binance Convert Recurring plans during the Promotion Period; and
Keep their Convert Recurring Plan active/ongoing throughout the Promotion Period.
## Important Notes:
Users must achieve a cumulative conversion volume of at least 75 USDC equivalent through Binance Convert Recurring within the Promotion Period to be eligible for rewards.
Any conversions executed before the user has registered their participation will not count toward this Promotion.
*Eligible users refer to users who trade via Binance Convert Recurring with new plans created during the Promotion Period and have completed all the aforementioned criteria listed in the Promotion.
Trading volume may be accumulated across multiple newly created bStock plans during the Promotion Period.
If multiple users have the same qualifying transaction time, rankings will be determined by transaction volume. Users with higher total eligible converted volume will rank higher.
Only Binance Convert trades completed via Recurring mode will count as successful trades for this Promotion.
Eligible participants’ Convert Recurring Plan must remain active/ongoing throughout the entire Promotion Period. If a user pauses or cancels their plan at any time during the Promotion Period, the trade amount from that plan will no longer count toward reward calculation.
Join the Promotion Now!
## Guides & Related Materials
All You Need to Know About Binance Convert
How to Use Binance Convert
Frequently Asked Questions on Binance Convert “Recurring”
A Beginner’s Guide to Candlestick Charts
How to Read the Most Popular Crypto Candlestick Patterns
bStocks Now Available on Binance Convert From Just 0.01 USDC Equivalent
## Terms and Conditions
All users must complete account verification and register their participation by clicking [Sign Up Now] on the Promotion page during the Promotion Period to be eligible for rewards.
To qualify for rewards, users need to complete the relevant trades on Binance Convert during the Promotion Period.
Promotion Period: 2026-11-26 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-23 23:59 (UTC). Each day is a 24-hour period from 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 (UTC).
The following types of trades will not count as eligible trades:
API trades on Binance Convert;
Stablecoin to stablecoin;
Converting old tokens that have previously undergone a token swap, redenomination or merging event, to the corresponding new token.
User Reward is capped at 0.01 SPCXB per user.
Trades on Binance Convert before or after the Promotion Period will not count toward the requirements of the Promotions.
Rewards will be distributed within three weeks after the Promotion Period. Users will be able to log in and redeem their token voucher rewards via Profile > Rewards Hub.
The validity period for the token voucher is set at 60 days from the day of distribution. Learn how to redeem a voucher. Eligible users should claim their vouchers before the expiration date. If a voucher is not claimed before its expiry, then it will be void and no replacement voucher nor other reward will be provided.
Users must have a valid, verified Binance account in good standing (not suspended, restricted, or under investigation) at the time of reward distribution to be eligible to receive rewards.
Sub-accounts will not be viewed as independent accounts when participating in the Promotion.
For clarity, Binance’s decisions with respect to all aspects of these Promotions are also final and non-appealable. For more information, see the Convert Services Terms.
In the event of any technical errors, system malfunctions, or discrepancies in the recording of conversion activity, Binance's records shall be the authoritative source. Binance reserves the right to correct any errors and adjust rewards accordingly.
Users are solely responsible for any tax obligations arising from their receipt of rewards under these Promotions. Binance makes no representation as to the tax treatment of any rewards in any jurisdiction.
Additional terms and conditions that also apply to this Promotion and are accessible here.
There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
